Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineEnabled_tooltip: Panic temporarily takes fatigue off the character, hiding the Tired debuff until they calm down.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineBoostSpeed_toolti: How quickly panic wakes the character up. Higher sheds the Tired debuff sooner.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineCrashSpeed_toolti: How quickly drowsiness returns once the character calms down.
Sandbox_QoLC_AdrenalineCrashPenalty_tool: How much extra fatigue is paid back on top of what adrenaline borrowed.
Sandbox_QoLC_PropanePumpCost_tooltip: Fuel drawn from a pump to fill one propane tank. A jerry can holds 10, a pump holds 22000.
Sandbox_QoLC_TailoringCutXpEnabled_toolt: Cutting a garment into strips teaches tailoring, and cutting gets quicker as the skill rises. Vanilla pays nothing for either.
Sandbox_QoLC_TailoringCutXp_tooltip: Percentage of the experience a cut garment is worth. Denim and leather pay per strip, cotton pays nothing, uniforms pay a bonus on top.
Sandbox_QoLC_AlarmHouseRule_tooltip: Stops a house alarm sounding for a house anyone could already have walked into. Unlocked doors covers many more houses than open ones, since vanilla leaves most exterior doors unlocked.
Sandbox_QoLC_AlarmVehiclesEnabled_toolti: Stops a car alarm sounding when a door or the trunk was left unlocked, a door or window stands open, or a window has been smashed out.
Sandbox_QoLC_ReadingCalmEnabled_tooltip: Reading a skill book slowly eases boredom, unhappiness and stress. The base game gives skill books no morale value at all, only comics and newspapers.
Sandbox_QoLC_ReadingCalmRate_tooltip: Percentage of the effect a page of a skill book is worth. Illness weakens it, and a fast reader gets less per page because they turn more of them.
Sandbox_QoLC_SleepRecoveryEnabled_toolti: Boredom and unhappiness fall while a character sleeps. The base game freezes both instead, so a night changes neither.
Sandbox_QoLC_SleepRecoveryRate_tooltip: Percentage of what a night's sleep is worth. At the default an eight hour night clears boredom and takes a quarter off unhappiness.
Sandbox_QoLC_SlingEnabled_tooltip: Wear a rifle or other long weapon on a sling. Off stops them spawning in loot and on dead soldiers. The recipe stays available, and slings already owned keep working.
Sandbox_QoLC_PropanePumpEnabled_tooltip: Refill a propane tank at a working fuel pump. The base game has no other way to refill one, so turning this off restores a hard ceiling on welding.
Sandbox_QoLC_BlowtorchEnabled_tooltip: A torch holds 16 uses instead of 10, and a propane tank refills it 30 times instead of about 7. Off restores the vanilla numbers.
Sandbox_QoLC_NutritionistMagEnabled_tool: Adds a magazine that teaches the Nutritionist trait, putting nutrition on the food the base game keeps quiet about: fresh produce, meat, foraged food and anything you cook. Tinned and boxed food already shows its label to anyone. It spawns wherever cooking magazines do, at half their odds.
